package rulefixtures

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
)

// scenario for validator_depends_on_repository_directly: Reusable validator code that reaches into repositories instead of receiving precomputed facts or focused services.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type UserRepository struct{}

func (r *UserRepository) ExistsByEmail(ctx context.Context, email string) (bool, error) {
	if email == "admin@example.com" {
		return true, nil
	}
	return false, nil
}

func ValidateNewUser(ctx context.Context, repo *UserRepository, email string, username string) error {
	if email == "" {
		return errors.New("email is required")
	}

	exists, err := repo.ExistsByEmail(ctx, email)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if exists {
		return errors.New("email already registered")
	}

	if username == "" {
		return errors.New("username is required")
	}

	return nil
}
